viewer_architecture.scope: Full Chennai Zarr Cube dataset viewer (UTM 400000..435000, 1420000..1470000)

band_selection.custom_3_band_assignment: User selects arbitrary bands for Red, Green, and Blue from 6 canonical channels
band_selection.single_band_grayscale: User selects any individual spectral band

visual_switcher.raster_visual: Pure satellite reflectance image sliced from Zarr
visual_switcher.hybrid_blend: Satellite reflectance with overlaid vector boundaries and interactive opacity slider (10% to 100%)
visual_switcher.vector_visual: Derived vector polygon footprints from local feature store

viewer_architecture.dossier_integration: Interactive 'ADD TO DOSSIER' button captures current dataset raster configuration and metadata directly into investigation store

/api/raster/composite.output_format: Base64 PNG with radiometric band statistics and STAC provenance
